scope: Paired development replication of a frozen policy. All eight outcomes count. These maps are excluded from final examination and cannot be used to fit these parameters.
examiner: Original complete search, unmodified temperature 1 and default random stream; map and physical seat paired, examiner random stream not controlled. Full official episode or extinction.
analysis: Compute candidate minus parent on identical map and physical seat for official margin and U. Report W/D/L, seat-specific margins and gains, each map mean (seats equally weighted) and equal-map mean for the two new maps. Show the original activation map separately. Keep all sign disagreements. Two maps give descriptive evidence and cannot establish population performance. Report a two-sided Student t 95% interval for the mean paired margin only as a sensitivity illustration under independent normal map effects (one degree of freedom). No change to formal 90 percent / +500 objective.
directional_repetition_rule: Describe repeated direction only if each replication map has positive mean paired margin and both physical seats improve U on each map. Absolute wins and possible official losses are reported separately.
resume: Reuse existing raw evidence only after full header and official replay checks; do not reroll a seat or replace the two registered maps after seeing outcomes.
